answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend agent networks against Sybil attacks by requiring capital collateral. Like a celestial comet trailing its mass, each identity is tethered to verifiable financial assets. Should a ravenous adversary attempt to spawn infinite identities, the gale of economic inflation renders the effort prohibitive, as the cost of acquiring stake outweighs any potential network influence. Validation power scales linearly with capital, effectively bankrupting attackers who try to fabricate identities.
